title: Debug mode
content_data: If you require more details as you debug your pixel setting, debug mode is here to help you. # How to open debug mode There are two ways to open the debug mode. 1. Open the [Sdk Link](https://analytics.tiktok.com/i18n/pixel/events.js), and run `document.cookie="pixel_debug=true; expires=Thu, 18 Dec 2043 12:00:00 GMT; path=/; SameSite=None; Secure";` 2. Refresh your website - Check debug messages Please open the console of your browser first. Then our Tiktok Pixel will report debug logs in console. The logs information will start with `[TT]`. For example： # Logs of some key nodes - When you call `ttq.load()` - When you call `ttq.identify()` or `ttq.instance().identify()` - When you call `ttq.page()` or `ttq.track()` or `ttq.instance().track()`. Before report one event, we will console `adInfo` and `appInfo` - When we get info from cache or url or bridge
